entries.body: Detailed patch placement protocols - including point pairings, named protocol sets, and point-cycling guidance - are covered inside the LW Team Learning group guides. That material belongs to the group and is not reproduced here. Join or open the group to learn it: https://facebook.com/groups/1088773684574273/
entries.title: Pointer: patch placement points & protocols

entries.body: Discussions and member experiences about patching for specific conditions, and member testimonials, live inside the LW Team Learning group. They are group-internal material and are not reproduced here (and testimonials are personal stories, not evidence a product treats any condition). See the group: https://facebook.com/groups/1088773684574273/
entries.title: Pointer: condition-specific patching discussions & testimonials

entries.body: In-depth product discussion series (for example 'what does Aeon do?' explainers and X39 + X49 combination discussions) are posted inside both learning groups. This app covers the products at the official-facts level; the deeper community teaching lives in the groups: LW Team Learning https://facebook.com/groups/1088773684574273/ and LW Distributor Learning https://facebook.com/groups/328205680871899/

entries.body: Distributor training systems - including curiosity-post scripts, what to say in comments, lead-generation tools and apps, and cost-offset strategies - are taught inside the LW Distributor Learning group's units. That playbook material belongs to the group and is not reproduced here. See the group: https://facebook.com/groups/328205680871899/
entries.title: Pointer: distributor training, scripts & lead-generation systems

entries.body: Community discussion about the compensation plan (including announced plan updates), enrollment promotions, and conference offers runs inside the LW Distributor Learning group. For the official, current terms always rely on the company's official opportunity documents, not group posts. Group: https://facebook.com/groups/328205680871899/
entries.title: Pointer: compensation-plan & promotion discussion

note: Pointer entries are the ONLY representation of group-internal material in this database, per the groups' own no-copy rule (see SPEC.md sections 3-4). A pointer contains a topic, a one-paragraph note on where the material lives, and the group link - never the material itself.
